this paper builds a model able to gauge the health standing of higher education in any country

units.source_excerpt: This paper establishes a model that can evaluate any country.
units.reusable_pattern: Restate a claim with this paper establishes.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not limit the model to one country.

units.rhetorical_move: says at the same time we consider the influence of national economic development

original_instantiations: the standard line is drawn
at the same time, the influence of national economic development is considered

units.source_excerpt: At the same time, we consider the influence of national economic development.
units.reusable_pattern: Add a claim with at the same time.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop the influence.

units.rhetorical_move: says we find that the health status has been greatly improved in the vision state

original_instantiations: two states are evaluated
the health status is found to have been greatly improved in the vision state

units.source_excerpt: We find that the health status has been greatly improved in the vision state.
units.reusable_pattern: Report a finding with has been greatly improved.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not soften greatly.

units.rhetorical_move: says we get that the policy can be effectively implemented and reach the ideal state

original_instantiations: the model is set up
the policy is found able to be effectively carried out and attain the ideal state

units.source_excerpt: We get that the policy can be effectively implemented and reach the ideal state.
units.reusable_pattern: Report a result with we get that.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the policy fails.

units.rhetorical_move: says finally we analyzed the impact of the plan and admitted that the change was difficult

original_instantiations: the result is reported
finally the impact of the plan is analyzed and the change is admitted to be difficult

units.source_excerpt: Finally, we analyzed the impact and admitted that the change was difficult.
units.reusable_pattern: Close a paper with admitted that the change was difficult.
reusable_elements: admitted that the change was difficult
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the change was easy.

units.rhetorical_move: numbers sources in brackets

original_instantiations: each source opens with a bracketed number
the heading reads reference

units.source_excerpt: Sources open with a bracketed number under a reference heading.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep the bracketed numbering.
prohibited_generalizations: The citation list belongs to this paper and does not transfer.
